name: Zombie horde
description: Blue and black Zombies that fill your graveyard, climb back out of it and crowd the board with 2/2 Zombie tokens to sacrifice.

cards.name: Morvane, Drowned Archivist
cards.rule_text:
At the beginning of your end step, mill two cards.
Whenever one or more creature cards are put into your graveyard from your library, create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
cards.flavor_text: She drowned with her books, and kept reading.

cards.name: Vorrik, the Stitched Tyrant
cards.rule_text:
Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
{1}, Sacrifice another Zombie: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent. Scry 1.

cards.name: Bell-Ringer of the Barrow
cards.rule_text:
Other Zombies you control get +1/+1.
{3}{B}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
cards.flavor_text: One toll for the living. Two for everyone else.

cards.name: Restless Ditch-Crawler
cards.rule_text:
CARDNAME can't block.
{2}{B}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Brine-Soaked Deckhand
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, mill three cards. If one or more Zombie cards were milled this way, draw a card.
cards.flavor_text: The ship sank years ago. Nobody told the crew.

cards.name: Fog-Wrapped Lamplighter
cards.rule_text:
Flying
When CARDNAME enters, draw a card, then discard a card.

cards.name: Corpsepile Hauler
cards.rule_text:
Menace
When CARDNAME dies, create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

cards.name: Sexton of the Saltmarsh
cards.rule_text:
Sacrifice another creature: Scry 1.
Whenever another Zombie you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you mill a card.

cards.name: Barrowpit Gravepicker
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, mill two cards. Then you may return a Zombie card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Bonepile Gorger
cards.rule_text: Whenever one or more creature cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. This ability triggers only once each turn.

cards.name: Dirge-Singing Ghoul
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, create two tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
cards.flavor_text: Its song has no words, but every grave knows the tune.

cards.name: Leviathan of the Drowned Fleet
cards.rule_text:
Ward {2}
When CARDNAME enters, tap up to two target creatures your opponents control. Those creatures don't untap during their controllers' next untap steps.

cards.name: Call of the Drowned Bell
cards.rule_text: Return up to two target Zombie creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
cards.flavor_text: Under the lake, the old bell still rings for the dead.

cards.name: Trawl the Black Shallows
cards.rule_text: Draw two cards, then mill two cards.

cards.name: Muster the Unburied
cards.rule_text: Create X tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.

cards.name: Grave-Tide Grasp
cards.rule_text: Return target creature to its owner's hand. If you control three or more Zombies, destroy that creature instead.

cards.name: Unquiet Burial Field
cards.rule_text: Whenever a nontoken Zombie you control dies, create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

cards.name: Altar of Bone and Brine
cards.rule_text:
Sacrifice a creature: Mill two cards.
{2}, {T}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

cards.name: Drowned Ossuary
cards.rule_text:
CARDNAME enters tapped.
{T}: Add {U} or {B}.
{2}, {T}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target Zombie card from your graveyard to your hand.
